chunks: From him, from ʿAmmār ibn al-Mubārak, from Ẓarīf ibn Nāṣiḥ, from al-Qāsim ibn al-Walīd al-Ghassānī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him, “May I be made your ransom,”
“The daytime salat of the nawāfil—how many is it?”
He said, “Sixteen. Whichever hours of the day you wish to perform it, you may perform it, except that if you perform it in its appointed times, that is more excellent.”

key_terms.النَّهَارِ: the daytime period in which these prayers are performed
key_terms.النَّوَافِلِ: supererogatory prayers beyond the obligatory salat
key_terms.سَاعَاتِ: hours or portions of the day
key_terms.سِتَّ عَشْرَةَ: sixteen, the total number mentioned for the daytime nawafil
key_terms.صَلَاةُ: salat (prayer), referring here to the devotional prayer being discussed

ai.seo_question: How many rakʿahs are the daytime nawafil, and can they be performed at any time during the day?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the daytime nawafil prayers are sixteen rakʿahs. It also indicates flexibility in performing them during the day, while emphasizing that observing their designated times is more virtuous.
